purpose: Where every identifier in content/m1 comes from. Nothing in this directory invents a concept id, a standard code, or a naming scheme; this file is the receipt for that.

registry.authority: Canonical. That package exists specifically because this repository accumulated at least eight incompatible curriculum vocabularies, and content authored against anything else becomes the ninth.
registry.editedInThisPass: Unlike the original 1765 content pass, the 2026-07-30 Coercive-Acts migration is ATOMIC and DID edit the registry (in the same branch): INTOLERABLE_ACTS and MERCANTILISM were reassigned M11 -> M1, POSTWAR_REVENUE and STAMP_SCOPE were demoted off M1 (mission null), and M11 dropped its 8.4(A) assignment. The three concepts below are the result. There is no deferred `followUp` to the registry from this pass; the registry and this file move together.

rescope.from: The 1765 Stamp-Act slate: POSTWAR_REVENUE, STAMP_SCOPE, REPRESENTATION.
rescope.to: The 1774 Coercive-Acts slate: INTOLERABLE_ACTS, REPRESENTATION, MERCANTILISM.
rescope.why: Aimed at the highest measured miss rates in content/staar/item-performance.json. See docs/design/M1-Remedial-Slice.md.
rescope.conceptCount: Three assessed concepts carry four teaching propositions. The six-macros-per-8.4(A)-clause invariant (packages/curriculum registry.test.ts) allows only one Coercive-Acts macro, so INTOLERABLE_ACTS carries BOTH the closure-as-collective-punishment proposition (case file 1) and the scope-of-the-four-acts proposition (case file 2); REPRESENTATION carries consent (file 3); MERCANTILISM carries forms-of-resistance / non-importation (file 4).

externalCorroboration.note: Not a source of ids, but worth recording next to them: all three concepts sit under 8.4(A), and content/staar establishes that TEA has published released 8.4(A) items on the coercion of Boston (2021 #38, 2022 #4) and on consent (2019 #24). Those measured items are the evidence the concept selection was derived from, and 2021 #38 / 2022 #4 are wired into the capstone's released-item map for INTOLERABLE_ACTS.
externalCorroboration.readOnly: content/staar is another agent's directory. Nothing here modifies it.

retiredFromM1.POSTWAR_REVENUE: Demoted to taught context, not an assessed concept (60% correct, the easiest measured 8.4(A) item). Registry `mission` set to null; its M1 module card, duel pool and Codex cards were retired. Definition kept.
retiredFromM1.STAMP_SCOPE: Dropped as an assessed concept (no released multiple-choice item tests it). Registry `mission` set to null; its M1 content retired. Definition kept, and the Stamp Act survives as the distinct EARLIER moment the lesson's sequencing teaches against.
